title: A lighter site, faster return visits
summary:
A lighter site, corrected image editing and chat streaming, clearer model information, and three more community projects in the catalog.

The main site now loads Markdown rendering only when needed and shows cached model availability, app listings, and highlights immediately on return visits while refreshing stale data in the background. Enter’s page titles and descriptions now describe the full image, text, video, and audio developer console.

Pruna p-image-edit now receives image URLs in the form it accepts; base64 and data URI inputs are uploaded first. Streaming chat completions now reject an upstream JSON response instead of treating it as an SSE stream.

Enter’s model pricing averages now exclude successful zero-price requests, correcting per-Pollen estimates without changing request or reliability counts. The API docs’ capabilities table also aligns names, endpoints, and formats across its renderers.

daily.title: Faster return visits
daily.text: Model availability, app listings, and highlights now render from cached data on return visits while stale entries refresh in the background. The site also loads less code up front.
